questions.questionText: What is classified as one of the four economic resources?

Countries X and Y have identical resources. The diagram shows their production possibility
curves.
food
drink
What can be concluded from the diagram?

options.text: X can produce food and drink more cheaply than Y.
X experiences higher unemployment than Y.
Y can produce food and drink more efficiently than X.
Y has higher retail prices than X.

first choice go to a cricket match
second choice watch the annual town parade
third choice go to the cinema
fourth choice visit relatives
Unfortunately a thunderstorm caused the cricket match and the town parade to be cancelled.
Sam went to the cinema.
What was the opportunity cost of going to the cinema?

An African government has abandoned its own dollar and now uses the US dollar as its currency.
Why would such a policy have been necessary?

options.text: Consumers only used credit cards rather than paper money.
Its own dollar no longer acted as a store of value.
The central bank controlled the issue of money too tightly.

options.text: a decrease in the average cost
a decrease in the total costs
an increase in the fixed costs
an increase in the variable costs

questions.questionText: What is characteristic of a monopoly market structure?

options.text: A monopolist may determine the price of its product.
A monopolist’s product has many substitutes.
There is easy entry into the market.

One aim of government policy is to redistribute income through taxation in order to reduce
inequality.
Which policy will achieve this aim?

options.text: Impose a tax of $0.20 on every dollar earned.
Increase the tax-free allowances after which tax must be paid progressively.
Introduce a tax on all food.
Provide an incentive to earn by reducing taxes for the highest paid.

questions.questionText: What is an example of expansionary monetary policy?

options.text: a decrease in income tax rates
a decrease in the budget deficit
a decrease in the money supply
a decrease in the rate of interest

questions.questionText: What are the components of the Human Development Index (HDI)?

options.text: life expectancy at birth, expected years of schooling, GDP
life expectancy at birth, expected years of schooling, GDP per head
population growth, adult literacy rate, GDP per head
population size, expected years of schooling, number of doctors per head

questions.questionText: Which government policy would reduce economic growth?

options.text: cutting the rate of corporation tax
lowering the rate of income tax

questions.questionText: What is a typical characteristic of a developing country?

options.text: equal distribution of income and wealth
high gross domestic product per head

questions.questionText:
In Botswana, better healthcare has meant that birth rates have been falling faster than death
rates. Also the number of children born, on average, to each woman has declined from 6.4 to 3.2.
What may be concluded from this information?

options.text: Government spending on education will need to increase.
Medical improvements have resulted in falling infant mortality rates.
There will be a decline in income for each person working.
There will, in the long run, be an increase in the working population.

What would cause a favourable change in the Kenyan trade in services (invisible) account?

options.text: A Kenyan company wins a contract to transport exports from Uganda.
A Kenyan tea company increases its exports.
A Kenyan trade delegation promoting coffee sales visits India.
A Zambian company increases its exports to Kenya.
